notes.title: Mission, costumes and other features of the update!
notes.content:
[h1]Dear players, check out our new update![/h1]
[list]
[*]The game’s first mission has arrived! Time to clear the scavengers out of Barley Manufacturing and earn XP, Woolongs, and materials. This mission has replaced the two corresponding territorial arenas.

[*]Stimulants, which used to be selectable before battle began, have been replaced with ammo, which can be crafted in the workshop and then used in battle. Ammo has a prolonged effect which is not lost when the character equipped with it dies.

[*]John no longer has Sniping Position, but he can shoot fine without it and always deals 100% damage.

[*]The smuggler’s shop now features suits that can change a mercenary’s appearance. Now, you can look like any scavenger or even get a cool exoskeleton. Also, a 4th item has been added to the random equipment set.
Bots are now smarter and craftier. They can use skills: robots transform, medics heal, and scouts hide and become invisible. 
[/list]
Good luck out there, and happy hunting!

notes.title: A new type of equipment - Implants!
notes.content:
We have prepared something new for you on the occasion of the New Year!

[h1]IMPLANTS[/h1]
Implants are a new type of equipment. They boost the mercenary parameters; implants of better quality can boost the attributes, and the best implants can do both at the same time.
[list]
[*]Each mercenary can be implanted with up to 4 such boosters.
[*]Each implant creates a load on the nervous system of a mercenary; it is presented by the parameter called NS-limit. The better the implant is, the more load it creates.
[*]The NS-limit of a mercenary increases with its grade and generation; the older the mercenary is, the better his implants can be.
[*]Implants can be found in the smugglers shop.
[*]You can insert or remove an implant from a mercenary in a Lab, which you can access via the Base.
[/list]

[h1]GRENADES AND first-aid KITS[/h1]
This update increases the battle effect of grenades and first aid—kits.
[list]
[*]Battle grenades deal more damage and first-aid kits restore more health.
[*]The bleeding caused by a frag grenade started to deal more damage; the better the quality of the grenade, the bigger is the damage from the bleeding.
[*]In opposition to this, the regeneration from the first-aid kits became much more effective. Besides, the first-aid kits and regenerators fully neutralize the bleeding caused by a grenade of the respective quality.
[*]The influence of the attributes and skills of a mercenary on the grenade and first-aid kit effect has changed.
[/list]

[h1]PREMIUM AND GIFTS[/h1]
Enjoy your 7-day Premium and free New Year Smugglers Chest in your inventory!

Finally, Energy was removed from the game and is no longer needed for any actions.

Good luck on the battlefield and a Happy New Year!

notes.title: Welcome to the game.
notes.content:
We are released in Early Access!  You can connect to the game and join fights with other bounty hunters.
Meanwhile we add Steam achivements to the game and assured that servers are stable. We'll try to finish before the new year.

In the nearest updates you will be expected:
[list]
[*] New items - implants. 
[*] Grenades and first-aid kits rebalance 
[/list]
